# Session-1 precision maps on session 2 (generated by scripts/analyze_quant_rule_study.py)

Every archived final model (459) was rounded with mixed-precision maps read from session-1 sensitivity only: a tensor keeps 8 bits if rounding it alone to 4 bits cost more than T points of session-1 accuracy (pooled: averaged over participants; own: that model's own number), else 4 bits. No retraining. Exploratory: the thresholds (2 and 0.5 points) were picked after the bit-width study's session-2 results were known.

- pooled-2: weights at 8 bits: conv_s; the rest 4. activations at 8 bits: input, conv_t, logits; the rest 4.
- pooled-0.5: weights at 8 bits: conv_s; the rest 4. activations at 8 bits: input, conv_t, conv_s, elu1, pool1, conv_d, logits; the rest 4.
- Check: float/float, 8/8 and 4/8 were scored again; 1 of 1377 of these accuracies differ from the bit-width study's records, the largest by 0.0036 (one trial whose rounding landed on the other side of a grid step).

Accuracy on artifact-free session-2 trials; seeds and conditions averaged within each participant; brackets: 95% participant bootstrap; 'n > 2': participants losing more than 2 points. Weight bytes and bit-operations are counted, not measured; below 8 bits nothing ran on a real low-bit kernel.
